{{Vanilla|Sandstone}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Sandstone''' is a stone made of compressed [[sand]]. [[Matcha Flavoured]] doubles its recipe output and adds ways to take it apart.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
* Four sand make 2 sandstone, where vanilla makes one; the vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sandstone.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
* A block of [[Brown Sandstone|brown sandstone]] crafts into 4 sandstone.
* A [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] turns smooth sandstone back into sandstone, and two sandstone slabs craft back into a block.
* Mined with the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tool intrinsic, sandstone drops smooth sandstone.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/sandstone.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
A sandstone crafts back into 2 sand. Two sandstone and two red sandstone make 4 [[Brown Sandstone|brown sandstone]]. In an upcoming update (not in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2-beta]]), doubled cut sandstone slabs show a large-brick texture; see [[Large bricks]].
